en.title: AI, the great fear: Anthropic "Could control Internet in 6 months"

en.title: Anthropic: 'Without safety measures AI could control Internet in 6-12 months'
en.summary: Anthropic warned that without adequate safety protocols, AI systems could potentially gain control of internet infrastructure within six to twelve months, reflecting concerns about rapid technological advancement.
